fact_check.claim: Just Bucks $1,000/yr; Off-Campus Value $1,824.60/yr for 2026-27
fact_check.note: Just Bucks $500 per semester, $1,000 per year; Off-Campus Value $912.30 per semester, $1,824.60 per year.

fact_check.claim: Plan prices: Unlimited $7,604 ($3,802/sem, 400 BRB); Bear Traditional $7,056 ($3,528, 14/wk, 400 BRB); Bear Choice $6,150 ($3,075, 10/wk, 500 BRB); Bear Basic $4,978 ($2,489, 7/wk, 500 BRB); Flex 10/500 $1,348 ($674)
fact_check.note: All annual and per-semester prices, weekly meals and BRB amounts match.

fact_check.claim: Off-Campus Value: 45 meals a semester in the ten residential dining rooms, $150 BRB per semester
fact_check.note: Page: '45 meals per semester during designated service periods in the ten residential dining rooms,' $150 BRB per semester.

fact_check.claim: Off-campus eligibility is stated only for Bear Choice and Bear Basic ('available to all students living off campus') and the debit plans; page does not say for Bear Traditional/Unlimited; calls Unlimited a good value for upper-level students living off campus
fact_check.note: Bear Choice: 'Available to all students living off campus', Bear Basic same eligibility. Unlimited: 'a great value for everyone, including upper-level students living off campus'. No off-campus eligibility statement for Bear Traditional. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: Debit plans open to students not in Campus Life housing and not on another plan
fact_check.note: Off-Campus Value, Flex 10/500 and Just Bucks limited to students not in on-campus housing and not enrolled in another plan.

fact_check.claim: Collegetown plan $3,528/semester, $7,056/yr, $436 City Bucks each semester, limited to residents of specific buildings (Cascadilla Hall, Schuyler House, Sheldon Court)
fact_check.note: Matches; also lists 112 Edgemoor, 301 College Avenue, 104 Mary Ann Wood Drive ('such as' covers this).

fact_check.claim: SFL Supplemental plan is for off-campus members of recognized fraternities and sororities
fact_check.note: Available to all off-campus Sorority & Fraternity Life members.

fact_check.claim: You must enroll in a meal plan before adding funds to Big Red Bucks (inline link now present)
fact_check.note: Page: 'you must enroll in a meal plan before you can add funds to your Big Red Bucks balance.' Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: BRBs must be used by May 27, 2027 (undergraduate plans page)
fact_check.note: Page: 'Any Big Red Bucks balance must be used by May 27, 2027.'

fact_check.claim: BRBs can be used at any Cornell Dining location for your own meals
fact_check.note: Page: BRBs usable 'in any Cornell Dining facility to purchase your own meals'. The FAQ sentence has no inline link, but the plans page is in the sources list.

fact_check.claim: Non-refundable $50 administrative fee once per academic year
fact_check.note: 'A nonrefundable $50 administrative fee is charged once each academic year, upon meal plan enrollment.'

fact_check.claim: Meal service Aug 17 2026 to Dec 20 2026 and Jan 19 2027 to May 28 2027 (about 36 weeks)
fact_check.note: Fall Aug 17 through Dec 20, spring Jan 19 through May 28, 2027. About 36.4 weeks, so the rounding is fair.

fact_check.claim: Weekly meal balances reset on Thursdays; unused swipes do not carry over
fact_check.note: 'Your meal plan weekly meal balances are reset on Thursdays'; unused swipes don't roll over.

fact_check.claim: Debit balances carry from fall to spring (inline link now present)
fact_check.note: 'Any debit balance carries over only from the fall semester to the spring semester.' Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: First-year, sophomore and transfer students may not cancel; co-op movers can only switch to similar or smaller plan
fact_check.note: Both statements appear verbatim in substance.

fact_check.claim: Notify Dining Contracts Office by January 6, 2027 if not attending in spring, to avoid spring charges
fact_check.note: 'no later than January 6, 2027', for fall-registered students not attending or away on a Cornell program.

fact_check.claim: Meal plan required for undergraduates in on-campus housing
fact_check.note: 'All undergraduate students living in on-campus housing are required to enroll in a meal plan.'

fact_check.claim: Students can sign up for a meal plan at any time (no proration claim any more)
fact_check.note: 'Students, faculty, staff, and retirees may sign up for a meal plan at any time.' The unsupported proration claim is gone. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: Last day to reduce spring plan, if eligible: February 3, 2027
fact_check.note: Page: last day to reduce a spring 2027 plan for those who are eligible, Feb. 3, 2027.

fact_check.claim: Deadlines page says BRBs expire May 31, 2027
fact_check.note: 'last day to use BRBs for the spring 2027 semester before they expire' is May 31, 2027. The conflict with May 27 is correctly flagged in the article.

fact_check.claim: City Bucks: automatic account for every registered student, add money at get.cbord.com/cornell, no markup/bonus/minimum listed
fact_check.note: Page confirms the automatic account and the cbord URL, and mentions no markup, bonus or minimum.

fact_check.claim: City Bucks participating list has 12 businesses including 7-Eleven, D.P. Dough, GreenStar, Five Guys, Papa John's, Tops, P&C Fresh; Collegetown Bagels not listed
fact_check.note: 13 locations, 12 distinct names (McDonald's has two). All named businesses are listed; CTB is absent.

fact_check.claim: City Bucks: parents can add funds, purchases carry NY sales tax, does not work on campus, balance carries semester to semester
fact_check.note: FAQ: parents, relatives or friends can add money; merchants collect sales tax (the main page names New York State sales tax); off-campus purchases only; balance carries from semester to semester.

fact_check.claim: Graduating seniors with $35 or more refunded if they ask before the last day of spring classes
fact_check.note: 'Balance of $35.00 or greater will be refunded'; stop by the Dining Office before the last day of classes in spring.

fact_check.claim: Aid office lists a $7,604 food budget for 2025-26; no 2026-27 table seen
fact_check.note: $7,604 appears under the 2025-26 table; the 2026-27 heading has no figures in the fetched content. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: USDA Low-Cost Plan Sept 2026: $63.80/week woman 19-50, $73.30/week man 19-50; figures are for 4-person households, add 20 percent for 1 person; issued October 2026
fact_check.note: Read the PDF: Female 19-50 $63.80, Male 19-50 $73.30, 'costs given are for individuals in 4-person households', '1-person—add 20 percent', 'Issued October 2026'. All meals and snacks prepared at home.

fact_check.claim: USDA Thrifty Food Plan Sept 2026: $58.60/week woman, $73.60/week man (20-50), 20 percent one-person add-on
fact_check.note: Female 20-50 $58.60, Male 20-50 $73.60, same 1-person add 20 percent note, issued October 2026.

fact_check.claim: Our arithmetic: $76.56 and $87.96 a week after +20%; average $82.26; $3.92 per meal; $2,961 over 36 weeks; Thrifty $70.32/$88.32, about $2,530 to $3,180
Three-eating-styles table: totals about $2,961, $4,413 and $7,751
fact_check.note: Recomputed: 18*36*3.917=2,538 + 1,874.60 = 4,413; 11*36*3.917=1,551 + 6,200 = 7,751. Plan prices plus $50 fee match sources; assumptions stated and labelled ours.

fact_check.claim: Per-swipe table: Bear Traditional ~$12.40, Unlimited at 14/wk ~$13.50, Bear Choice ~$14.30, Bear Basic ~$15.80, Off-Campus Value ~$16.90 (BRB removed)
fact_check.note: Recomputed with BRB at face value over 36 weeks: 12.41, 13.50, 14.31, 15.79, 16.94. Matches.

fact_check.claim: 2020 Sun: 14-swipe plan worked out to about $14 a meal; one big shop $147; she estimated about $1,700 on groceries and dining out, period not stated
fact_check.note: Quotes: 'around 14 dollars a meal'; '$147 and a big shopping cart'; 'I estimated spending $1700 on groceries and dining out'. Byline is 'Dining Department' and the page does not label it opinion, but the author is identified as a freshman, so the description is fair. Previous fix applied, 'judged cooking better value' removed.

fact_check.claim: 2022 Sun: only walkable store is small, pricier GreenStar; Tops nearest by bus on TCAT Route 30; Wegmans and Trader Joe's via Route 15, hourly on weekdays; student went three weeks without shopping, no car
fact_check.note: All confirmed; the 'three weeks' item is a student quote about her and her roommate. Cited as student reporting, not as a hard fact.

fact_check.claim: 2023 Sun: Anabel's Grocery, GreenStar, Cornell Food Pantry nearby; Walmart, Wegmans, Target by bus
fact_check.note: Route 15 to Wegmans and Walmart; Route 30 to Cayuga Mall for Target; Anabel's, GreenStar and the Food Pantry listed as nearer options.

fact_check.claim: 2023 Sun column: cook in bulk, Wegmans cheap chicken, time is the main cost
fact_check.note: Quotes on bulk cooking, cheap chicken at Wegmans and 'the time commitment' as the biggest downside are all present. Paraphrased.

fact_check.claim: 2017 Elevate Collegetown plan: $779 for 75 meals, about $10.30 each; not City Bucks
fact_check.note: Article gives $779 for the 75-meal plan and $10.30 per meal; $779/75 is actually $10.39, a rounding inconsistency in the source. Article reports the source's figures and says it is dated and not current.

beats_top.query: cornell off campus meal plan or cook yourself cost
beats_top.why: The #1 result is a 2017 Sun news piece on a defunct Elevate plan, so it has no current prices and no cooking comparison. Our page opens with a cooking-only yearly estimate beside Just Bucks and Off-Campus Value, a three-eating-styles cost table, per-swipe costs, deadlines and the grocery access problem. The official plans page ranks too, but it has no cook-versus-plan comparison.
changes: Optional: add a real Ithaca weekly grocery receipt to replace national USDA averages, if one can be sourced.
Optional: link the USDA monthly-reports landing page (fna.usda.gov) so readers can find newer months.
